newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Bufete wins bridge contract.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Bufete wins bridge contract.

text.p: Construction firm Bufete Industrial said Monday it won a unit-price contract from Interloma SA for the procurement and construction of a road complex in the Santa Fe district of Mexico City.
Bufete gave no figure for the contract which it will carry out through its wholly-owned subsidiary for construction and infrastructure projects Constructora URBEX.
The project involves building three bridges and is scheduled to be completed by November 1997, generating 1,000 direct and indirect jobs.
